channel.title: SIREN — daily brief
channel.description: One entry per UTC day: the closing SIREN reading and the day's highest-scoring AI stories. SIREN measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.

item.title: SIREN daily brief · 2026-11-13
